title: Beyond the Pixels: VLM-based Evaluation of Identity Preservation in Reference-Guided Synthesis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating generative models on a newly constructed benchmark that balances photorealistic images with underrepresented artistic styles, such as vector art and cartoon rendering, to reveal performance disparities across different visual aesthetics.

Assessing identity preservation performance across a diverse set of subject categories, specifically including historically underrepresented types like anthropomorphic characters and inanimate animated subjects, alongside standard human and animal subjects.
